name: Psychokinetic Talent
body:
–

Benefit: You can expend your psionic focus as a swift action to manifest far hand as a psi-like ability. It has a duration of one round, a range of ten feet, and allows you to move a maximum weight of 1 lb. If you have psionic power points, you may expend one to extend the duration of this psi-like ability by one round. This talent grants no benefit if you do not have the ability to gain psionic focus.
